title: an elegant swing break turns the coral to glass, gently
story: Pa Curubandé at 136 BPM, a relaxed son-swing: the loop plays steady through the pre-roll (rms 0.28) and then drops into the break at 1129, where the level steps down (rms 0.28 -> 0.18, -2.39 sd) and the bright percussive peaks thin out. This is a slow part, so slow stays slow (rule 30): the coral is left as it is, and the material only seasons it — a glass skin is mixed in across the break, at its strongest on the two bright peaks (1184, 1267), with one short broken-surface glitch on the 11.56 accent at 1267 that lands on the hit and is gone by the next beat. The palette motion breathes a little per bar; nothing about the tempo changes.
